transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Well, it's a burning feeling when I pass water, and I'm needing to go much more often than usual. It started about four days ago.
In your own words, how much is this bothering you or getting in the way of your day-to-day life, and what can you tell me about any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?

The stinging is about a 5 out of 10 — uncomfortable, but I'm managing. I have stopped going to the residents' coffee morning, though, in case I can't reach a toilet in time. As for medicines, I'm allergic to trimethoprim; it gave me an itchy rash.
Could you tell me about any other medicines you take regularly or have taken recently, including doses if you know them, and any past health problems, operations, or hospital stays?

I take levothyroxine, 75 micrograms each morning, and alendronic acid, 70 mg once a week, for thin bones. I also use a vaginal cream from the hospital twice a week, but I can't remember its name. I have an underactive thyroid, and I had a water infection about a year ago that was treated with antibiotics — I haven't had any operations.
Could you describe where you feel the burning — whether it stays in one spot or goes anywhere else — and anything else you’ve noticed along with it?

It's a stinging down below when I pass water, and it doesn't spread anywhere else — it's just there when I go. I've also noticed the urine looks cloudy and smells stronger than usual, though I haven't seen any blood.

What, if anything, have you noticed makes the stinging when you pass water, or needing to go more often, better or worse — anything you eat or drink, things you do, positions, medicines, or anything else?
I can't say I've noticed anything that makes it better or worse — not food, drink, or anything I do. It just seems to be there whenever I go.
Is there anything else you take, even now and then, that we haven’t talked about?
No, that's everything. I don't take anything else, not even now and then.
What worries you most about what you’ve been noticing, or what are you hoping to get from today’s visit?
I think it's another water infection, like the one I had last year. What I'm hoping for is to get some antibiotics before the weekend.

Besides your underactive thyroid and the water infection you had about a year ago, is there anything else about your past health — other ongoing conditions, past illnesses, or hospital stays — that you think I should know about?

Well, I have thin bones — that's what the alendronic acid is for. I also get the vaginal cream from the hospital, so I've been seen there for that. Apart from those, no other ongoing conditions or hospital stays that I can think of.

Besides the burning when you pass water, needing to go more often, the cloudy and stronger-smelling urine, and not having seen any blood, is there anything else you’ve noticed that you think I should know about?
No, I haven't had any fever, shivers, back or side pain, or vomiting, and my niece hasn't noticed any new confusion. Nothing else I can think of.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
